messages:
raj: FYI seeing gradual GPU memory growth on long-context runs with the paged KV cache. H100 runs show ~+200MB per 1k tokens; MI250 looks different but fragmentation jumps after ~20k tokens.

matt: repro command?

raj: run: `./runner --model redwood/v1 --longctx 32k --batch 1`. Short kvcache stats dump: 
```
KVCache: pages_total=10240 pages_free=128 pages_frag=4128 remap_ops=432
longctx_tokens=21000 memory_used_mb=14200
```

elaine: can you get page-table snapshots pre/post? I suspect a remap path is leaving shadow pages pinned (remap bit not cleared).

raj: saved a trimmed dump to /tmp/pt-snap-3723456789.txt. Example diff: 
```
- owner: cpu0 page:0x7f1a
+ owner: gpu1 page:0x7f1a ref=3 state=SHADOW
```

sara: saw something similar on the async-evict canary — coalesce path didn't zero fragment counts, reuse window kept growing. Repro flags: `--kv-async-evict --prefetch=auto`.

matt: @raj can you run with `KVCACHE_DEBUG=pt:trace` and capture remap failures? Also capture memcpy/evict latencies (cudaMemcpy and peer copies).

raj: debug run shows lots of pt_walk churn and `remap_failed` entries. Snippet: 
```
[pt] remap_failed page=0x7f1a reason=stale-owner
[pt] alloc_shadow page=0x7f1a new_owner=gpu1
```

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T14:22:31 started: candidate kernel patch kvcache/evict-rate-limiter to reduce eviction bursts.

elaine: quick experiment idea — bump reuse_threshold to prefer leaving pages mapped rather than aggressive coalesce+remap; also check for slot index wraparound in page allocator. I'll prototype a fix to clear fragment_count on coalesce.

raj: good plan. Filed INF ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9345 with traces and per-page timestamps. I'll run the cross-GPU matrix (H100/A100/MI250) overnight.

matt: if you get a minimal repro we can bisect commits since 2026-02-10; my guess is a kernel-selection tweak changed eviction ordering under high batching.

sara: note — larger batching heuristics amplify the problem because they write more KV pages per cycle; that increases remap contention. We should test with small vs large batch sizes.

elaine: ok leaving this for triage tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
